hook.name: hook
hook.reason: Alexander's intense declaration 'Enough hiding' paired with his scarred face and mirror reflection immediately sets up a vengeful return.

narrative_tension.name: narrative_tension
narrative_tension.reason: Tension escalates steadily from his personal resolve in the cabin to commanding loyalist troops in the snow and marching purposefully toward his goal.

cliffhanger.name: cliffhanger
cliffhanger.reason: The final vow to bring his wife home combined with the push-in on his fierce gaze creates a strong forward pull toward his impending confrontation.
cliffhanger.open_question: What will happen when Alexander storms the chapel to take back his house and wife?

context_independence.name: context_independence
context_independence.reason: The core premise is entirely self-evident: a powerful, scarred man thought to be dead is returning to reclaim his status, his estate, and his wife.
context_independence.blind_summary: A scarred man named Alexander reclaims his identity as a duke after being buried for three years, ordering his men to secure a chapel as he marches to take back his house and his wife. The clip ends on his fierce vow before cutting to black.

confusions.issue: Who buried him and why he had to hide for three years is unexplained.
What happened to his wife and who currently holds his house remains unknown.

curiosity_gap.name: curiosity_gap
curiosity_gap.reason: The clip clearly establishes the protagonist's mission and stakes while leaving the obstacles and immediate confrontation entirely unseen.
revealed: He is a duke returning for his house and wife
withheld: The current situation of his wife

emotional_impact.name: emotional_impact
emotional_impact.reason: The transformation and confident march of the protagonist evoke a strong sense of impending justice and powerful retribution.

stakes.value: A presumed-dead duke returns from exile to reclaim his stolen title, estate, and wife.

curiosity_revealed: He is a duke returning for his house and wife
curiosity_withheld: The current situation of his wife
promo_dna.appeal: A scarred duke returns from the dead to take back his empire and his wife.
